WITH raw_base AS (
         SELECT cfe.id,
            cfe.site_id,
            cfe.date AS entry_date,
            cfe.particular,
            cfe.remarks,
            COALESCE(cfe.debit, 0::numeric) AS raw_debit,
            COALESCE(cfe.credit, 0::numeric) AS raw_credit,
            COALESCE(cfe.source_module, 'personal_ledger'::character varying) AS source_key,
            cfe.source_id,
                CASE cfe.source_module
                    WHEN 'plot_payments'::text THEN pp.status
                    WHEN 'plot_installment_payments'::text THEN pip.status
                    WHEN 'farmer_payments'::text THEN fp.status
                    WHEN 'expenses'::text THEN ex.status
                    WHEN 'plot_commission_payments'::text THEN pcp.status
                    WHEN 'vendor_payments'::text THEN vp.status
                    WHEN 'plot_registry_payments'::text THEN prp.status
                    WHEN 'firm_transactions'::text THEN ft.status
                    WHEN 'day_book'::text THEN db.status
                    ELSE cfe.status
                END AS status,
                CASE cfe.source_module
                    WHEN 'plot_payments'::text THEN pp.cheque_status
                    WHEN 'plot_installment_payments'::text THEN pip.cheque_status
                    WHEN 'farmer_payments'::text THEN fp.cheque_status
                    WHEN 'expenses'::text THEN ex.cheque_status
                    WHEN 'plot_commission_payments'::text THEN pcp.cheque_status
                    WHEN 'vendor_payments'::text THEN vp.cheque_status
                    WHEN 'plot_registry_payments'::text THEN prp.cheque_status
                    WHEN 'firm_transactions'::text THEN ft.cheque_status
                    WHEN 'day_book'::text THEN db.cheque_status
                    ELSE cfe.cheque_status
                END AS cheque_status,
                CASE cfe.source_module
                    WHEN 'plot_payments'::text THEN pp.cheque_no
                    WHEN 'plot_installment_payments'::text THEN pip.cheque_no
                    WHEN 'farmer_payments'::text THEN fp.cheque_no
                    WHEN 'expenses'::text THEN ex.cheque_no
                    WHEN 'plot_commission_payments'::text THEN pcp.cheque_no
                    WHEN 'vendor_payments'::text THEN vp.cheque_no
                    WHEN 'plot_registry_payments'::text THEN prp.cheque_no
                    WHEN 'firm_transactions'::text THEN ft.cheque_no
                    WHEN 'day_book'::text THEN db.cheque_no
                    ELSE cfe.cheque_no
                END AS cheque_no,
            cfe.created_at,
            cfe.cash_flow_month_id,
            cfe.assigned_admin_id,
            cfe.bank_account_id,
            ba.name AS bank_account_name,
            COALESCE(pp.payment_type, pip.payment_mode, fp.payment_mode, ex.payment_mode, pcp.payment_mode, vp.payment_mode, prp.payment_mode, ft.payment_mode, db.payment_mode, cfe.cash_type) AS raw_mode,
            COALESCE(cfe.voucher_url, fp.voucher_url, pp.voucher_url, vp.voucher_url::character varying, ex.voucher_url, db.voucher_url) AS voucher_url,
            COALESCE(f.name, pp.buyer_name, vc.vendor_name, NULLIF(cfm.ledger_name::text, ''::text)::character varying, NULLIF(db.to_entity::text, ''::text)::character varying, NULLIF(db.from_entity::text, ''::text)::character varying, NULLIF(cfe.to_name::text, ''::text)::character varying, cfe.particular) AS entity_name,
            COALESCE(
                CASE
                    WHEN p.plot_no IS NOT NULL THEN concat('Plot ', p.plot_no,
                    CASE
                        WHEN p.block IS NOT NULL THEN concat(' · Block ', p.block)
                        ELSE ''::text
                    END)
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(cfm.ledger_name::text, ''::text) IS NOT NULL THEN concat(initcap(COALESCE(cfm.ledger_type, 'site'::character varying)::text), ' ledger · ', cfm.ledger_name)
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END, NULLIF(concat_ws(' → '::text, NULLIF(db.from_entity::text, ''::text), NULLIF(db.to_entity::text, ''::text)), ''::text), NULLIF(cfe.remarks, ''::text)) AS linked_detail,
            lower(COALESCE(cfm.ledger_type, ''::character varying)::text) AS ledger_type,
            upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(p.plot_tag, pip_p.plot_tag, ''::character varying))) AS plot_tag,
            COALESCE(u.name, 'System'::character varying) AS created_by_name,
            cfe.source_module::text = 'farmer_payments'::text AND upper(COALESCE(fp.payment_mode, ''::character varying)::text) = 'SPLIT'::text AND (COALESCE(fp.cash_amount, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(fp.bank_amount, 0::numeric)) > 0::numeric AS is_split,
            COALESCE(fp.cash_amount, 0::numeric) AS split_cash,
            COALESCE(fp.bank_amount, 0::numeric) AS split_bank
           FROM cash_flow_entries cfe
             LEFT JOIN cash_flow_months cfm ON cfm.id = cfe.cash_flow_month_id
             LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = cfe.created_by
             LEFT JOIN bank_accounts ba ON ba.id = cfe.bank_account_id
             LEFT JOIN farmer_payments fp ON cfe.source_module::text = 'farmer_payments'::text AND fp.id = cfe.source_id
             LEFT JOIN farmers f ON f.id = fp.farmer_id
             LEFT JOIN plot_payments pp ON cfe.source_module::text = 'plot_payments'::text AND pp.id = cfe.source_id
             LEFT JOIN plots p ON p.id = pp.plot_id
             LEFT JOIN plot_installment_payments pip ON cfe.source_module::text = 'plot_installment_payments'::text AND pip.id = cfe.source_id
             LEFT JOIN plots pip_p ON pip_p.id = pip.plot_id
             LEFT JOIN expenses ex ON cfe.source_module::text = 'expenses'::text AND ex.id = cfe.source_id
             LEFT JOIN plot_commission_payments pcp ON cfe.source_module::text = 'plot_commission_payments'::text AND pcp.id = cfe.source_id
             LEFT JOIN vendor_payments vp ON cfe.source_module::text = 'vendor_payments'::text AND vp.id = cfe.source_id
             LEFT JOIN vendor_commitments vc ON vc.id = vp.commitment_id
             LEFT JOIN plot_registry_payments prp ON cfe.source_module::text = 'plot_registry_payments'::text AND prp.id = cfe.source_id
             LEFT JOIN firm_transactions ft ON cfe.source_module::text = 'firm_transactions'::text AND ft.id = cfe.source_id
             LEFT JOIN day_book db ON cfe.source_module::text = 'day_book'::text AND db.id = cfe.source_id
          WHERE cfe.date >= '1900-01-01'::date AND cfe.date <= '2100-12-31'::date AND (COALESCE(cfe.source_module, ''::character varying)::text <> ALL (ARRAY['imprest'::character varying::text, 'imprest_requests'::character varying::text, 'document_imprest'::character varying::text, 'document_imprest_requests'::character varying::text, 'plot_commissions'::character varying::text, 'plot_registry_payments'::character varying::text])) AND NOT (cfe.source_module::text = 'day_book'::text AND upper(COALESCE(db.entry_type, ''::character varying)::text) = 'IMPREST'::text) AND COALESCE(cfe.source_module, ''::character varying)::text !~ '_person$'::text
        ), base AS (
         SELECT raw_base.id,
            raw_base.site_id,
            raw_base.entry_date,
            raw_base.particular,
            raw_base.remarks,
            raw_base.raw_debit,
            raw_base.raw_credit,
            raw_base.source_key,
            raw_base.source_id,
            raw_base.status,
            raw_base.cheque_status,
            raw_base.cheque_no,
            raw_base.created_at,
            raw_base.cash_flow_month_id,
            raw_base.assigned_admin_id,
            raw_base.bank_account_id,
            raw_base.bank_account_name,
            raw_base.raw_mode,
            raw_base.voucher_url,
            raw_base.entity_name,
            raw_base.linked_detail,
            raw_base.ledger_type,
            raw_base.plot_tag,
            raw_base.created_by_name,
            raw_base.is_split,
            raw_base.split_cash,
            raw_base.split_bank,
                CASE
                    WHEN financial_transaction_posts(
                    CASE
                        WHEN raw_base.raw_debit < 0::numeric THEN 'credit'::text
                        ELSE 'debit'::text
                    END, raw_base.status::text, raw_base.raw_mode::text, raw_base.cheque_status::text) THEN raw_base.raw_debit
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS debit,
                CASE
                    WHEN financial_transaction_posts(
                    CASE
                        WHEN raw_base.raw_credit < 0::numeric THEN 'debit'::text
                        ELSE 'credit'::text
                    END, raw_base.status::text, raw_base.raw_mode::text, raw_base.cheque_status::text) THEN raw_base.raw_credit
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS credit,
            financial_transaction_posts(
                CASE
                    WHEN raw_base.raw_debit < 0::numeric THEN 'credit'::text
                    ELSE 'debit'::text
                END, raw_base.status::text, raw_base.raw_mode::text, raw_base.cheque_status::text) AS debit_posts
           FROM raw_base
        ), posted AS (
         SELECT base.id,
            base.site_id,
            base.entry_date,
            base.particular,
            base.remarks,
            base.raw_debit,
            base.raw_credit,
            base.source_key,
            base.source_id,
            base.status,
            base.cheque_status,
            base.cheque_no,
            base.created_at,
            base.cash_flow_month_id,
            base.assigned_admin_id,
            base.bank_account_id,
            base.bank_account_name,
            base.raw_mode,
            base.voucher_url,
            base.entity_name,
            base.linked_detail,
            base.ledger_type,
            base.plot_tag,
            base.created_by_name,
            base.is_split,
            base.split_cash,
            base.split_bank,
            base.debit,
            base.credit,
            base.debit_posts
           FROM base
          WHERE base.debit <> 0::numeric OR base.credit <> 0::numeric
        )
 SELECT posted.id::text AS id,
    posted.site_id,
    posted.entry_date,
    posted.particular,
    posted.remarks,
    posted.debit,
    posted.credit,
    ledger_bucket(posted.raw_mode::text) AS bucket,
    lower(COALESCE(posted.raw_mode, 'cash'::character varying)::text) AS raw_mode,
    posted.source_key,
    posted.source_id,
    posted.status,
    posted.cheque_status,
    posted.cheque_no,
    posted.voucher_url,
    posted.entity_name,
    posted.linked_detail,
    posted.ledger_type,
    posted.created_by_name,
    posted.created_at,
    posted.cash_flow_month_id,
    posted.assigned_admin_id,
    posted.plot_tag,
    posted.bank_account_id,
    posted.bank_account_name
   FROM posted
  WHERE NOT posted.is_split
UNION ALL
 SELECT concat(base.id, ':cash') AS id,
    base.site_id,
    base.entry_date,
    base.particular,
    base.remarks,
    base.split_cash AS debit,
    0::numeric AS credit,
    'cash'::text AS bucket,
    'cash'::text AS raw_mode,
    base.source_key,
    base.source_id,
    base.status,
    base.cheque_status,
    base.cheque_no,
    base.voucher_url,
    base.entity_name,
    concat_ws(' · '::text, base.linked_detail, 'Cash part of split payment') AS linked_detail,
    base.ledger_type,
    base.created_by_name,
    base.created_at,
    base.cash_flow_month_id,
    base.assigned_admin_id,
    base.plot_tag,
    NULL::integer AS bank_account_id,
    NULL::character varying AS bank_account_name
   FROM base
  WHERE base.is_split AND base.debit_posts AND base.split_cash > 0::numeric
